question: Should meeting-capture transcripts advance the shared state database to schema version 4 now, using the same SQLite-only runtime and exclusive Doctor migration contract as the merged APNs and Web Push migrations?
rationale: Repository policy reserves schema-version advancement and persistent migration direction for explicit maintainer acceptance, while the linked issue still carries an unresolved product-decision signal.

options.title: Approve canonical SQLite migration
